snippet.title: The Studio of Zabendo - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Warning: This trailer it's about The Studio Of Zabendo - Announcement. The trailer was made to introduce the game idea and the main character, the game in developement check the Steam Page.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567820/The_Maze_of_Zabendo/

Previous Description:
You play as Theodore Abescar, a detective who is determined to find out what happened to his favorite park and cartoon when he was a child.

Theodore really liked of a cartoon as a child, the cartoon was called Zabendo, a cartoon dedicated to children, the Studio called Hope & Dream Studio, after the success of the cartoon, started selling products, making plays and most importantly, an amusement park! But one day the owner of all this empire was arrested but the media didn't make it clear why he was arrested but now as an adult Theo will discover the truth on his own.

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567820/The_Studio_of_Zabendo/
